description: This file defines the class AndroidInlineAllStyleUsagesProcessor, which extends BaseRefactoringProcessor to perform refactoring operations related to inlining Android styles within an IDE environment. It manages usage detection, conflict resolution, and the actual inlining process for style resources.

classes.name: AndroidInlineAllStyleUsagesProcessor
classes.description: A class that handles the inlining of style usages in Android projects, extending BaseRefactoringProcessor to manage the refactoring lifecycle including usage detection, conflict resolution, and execution.

methods.name: createUsageViewDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a descriptor for the usage view, indicating the style element to be inlined and the references to be processed.

methods.name: findUsages
methods.description: Finds all usages of the style element and related resource fields that need to be inlined.

methods.name: performRefactoring
methods.description: Performs the inlining of style usages based on the collected usage information.

methods.name: preprocessUsages
methods.description: Detects conflicts before performing refactoring, especially in unit test mode.

methods.name: detectConflicts
methods.description: Analyzes usages to identify conflicts such as non-XML usages, unsupported usages, or ambiguous references.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name for the refactoring operation.

methods.name: getUndoConfirmationPolicy
methods.description: Specifies the undo confirmation policy, requesting user confirmation for undo operations.
